title: George Wasn't Invited To The Choe Show

items.name: Khalyla
items.context: A TigerBelly clip follows George Kimmel’s complaint that Khalyla attended The Choe Show while he was not invited, questions whether he applied seriously and ends with an attempt to arrange a remaining-week visit.
items.reading: Khalyla recurs in 10 reviewed routes; this card records context, not an appearance or voice claim.
